title: Microsoft Azure SQL Workshop azuremlsampleexperiments Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to manipulate sample datasets on affected installations of SQL Workshop for Microsoft Azure. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the installation of SQL Workshop. When installed from the official Microsoft GitHub repository, the installation attempts to load a non-existent cloud resource that is vulnerable to takeover. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to manipulate sample datasets on systems dependent on the cloud resource.
